links.comparator_used: Initial LLM-generated scenarios without expert review (pre-revision scores); publicly available human-authored scenarios served as an external benchmark
links.outcome: Simulation Scenario Evaluation Tool (SSET) score out of 100 for MCI simulation scenarios
links.effect: Median SSET 78.5 (IQR 74-82) for initial LLM scenarios vs 94 (IQR 93-96) after human revision; publicly available scenarios scored 94 (IQR 93-95). Interrater ICC 0.965 before revision and 0.7425 after.
links.tradeoff: Expert review and iterative refinement required reviewer time (review time was recorded). Interrater reliability fell after revision (ICC 0.965 to 0.7425).
links.quote: Following secondary human revision and iterative refinement, the LLM-generated scenarios improved, achieving a median SSET score of 94 (IQR 93-96) with an interrater reliability ICC of 0.7425.

design_hint: expert human review and iterative refinement
